{{Quote|The next person that needs aid is Jorund Redd. I will give you a waypoint to his home.|[[2-1b-58|Billingsly]], to a medic|<ref name="SWG:CitC" />}}
'''Jorund Redd''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the desert world [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I need you to take care of a couple of patients that got caught in a territory war in Mos Eisley.|Billingsly, to a medic|<ref name="SWG:CitC" />}}
Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Jorund Redd resided in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. The man had friends in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and was in contact with [[Droma Ordo]] in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]].<ref name="SWG:CitC" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Redd and a woman named [[Escara Frei]] were caught in a fight between [[Valarian/Legends|Lady Valarian's]] [[Valarian Syndicate|guards]] and [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|thugs]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. The man got hit on his head very hard and started feeling very sick. A [[Medic/Legends|medic]] was sent by the [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B droid]] [[2-1b-58|Billingsly]] to help [[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]] [[Nillika]] and the the local medical staff. When the medic examined Redd and wanted to treat his wounds, thieves sent by Valarian's aide [[Kavas Urdano]] attacked the medic. The medic managed to kill both thieves and then treated Redd's injuries. Redd then suggested that the medic may contact Droma Ordo to work for the Alliance.<ref name="SWG:CitC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jorund Redd was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CitC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Jorund Redd was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>

Jorund Redd could be found in Mos Eisley as part of the low-level quest "[[W:c:swg:Caught in the Crossfire|Caught in the Crossfire]]," for players of the [[W:c:swg:Medic|Medic profession]]. The player was given the mission by Billingsly, and only needed to talk to Redd in order to treat his wounds. As soon as his wounds were healed, two thief NPCs attacked the player, and a comm message from Kavas Urdano warned the player not to interfere with Valarian's business.<ref name="SWG:CitC" />
